Dyson Purifier Cool PC2 De-NOx TP12 Air Purifier and Fan

The Dyson Purifier Cool PC2 De-NOx TP12 is Dyson's most advanced air purifier. It does what every other purifier on the Pakistani market does — captures dust, allergens and particles — and then goes significantly further. The Dyson Purifier Cool PC2 De-NOx has all the capabilities of Dyson's Purifier Cool Formaldehyde products but goes a step further to capture more NO₂. The new K-Carbon filter is impregnated with potassium carbonate and can adsorb 50% more nitrogen dioxide — a common and potentially harmful household pollutant produced by gas appliances, open flames and wood burning stoves. For Pakistani homes where gas stoves are used daily in every kitchen, this is one of the most directly relevant air purification features available anywhere in the market today.

Why Air Quality Inside Pakistani Homes Is Worse Than You Think

Most people in Pakistan think about outdoor air pollution — the smog over Lahore, the dust in Karachi, the vehicle fumes on busy roads. But indoor air quality is often worse than outdoor air quality, and it is something most households never address.

Pakistani homes produce significant indoor air pollutants daily. Gas stoves burning for breakfast, lunch and dinner release nitrogen dioxide directly into the kitchen and surrounding rooms. Cooking oils and food produce volatile organic compounds. Cleaning products and aerosols release gases. Dust, pollen and allergens enter through windows and doors constantly. In homes where all windows are closed for air conditioning during summer, these pollutants accumulate with nowhere to go.

The Dyson TP12 De-NOx is built specifically to address all of these pollutants simultaneously — the particles you can see, the gases you cannot see and the formaldehyde that exists in trace amounts in almost every modern home from furniture, flooring and household products.

What the De-NOx Technology Actually Does

The K-Carbon filter is impregnated with potassium carbonate and can adsorb 50% more nitrogen dioxide than regular activated carbon performance. Standard activated carbon filters used in other air purifiers adsorb some NO₂ but not effectively. The K-Carbon filter in the TP12 De-NOx uses a potassium carbonate impregnation that chemically reacts with NO₂ molecules and converts them, removing them from the air at a rate 50% higher than standard carbon filters. For a home where gas cooking happens three times a day, this level of NO₂ removal is a significant improvement to the air your family breathes every day.

Formaldehyde Destroyed Permanently — Not Just Captured

Formaldehyde is present in almost every home through off-gassing from furniture, flooring, paint and household products. It is colourless, odourless and genuinely harmful to health at elevated levels. Most air purifiers that claim to address formaldehyde simply capture it in a filter — which means the filter becomes saturated over time and either needs replacing or starts releasing formaldehyde back into the air.

The TP12 De-NOx handles formaldehyde differently. It continuously destroys formaldehyde with a permanent catalytic filter. The formaldehyde-destroying catalytic filter never needs replacing. The catalytic filter breaks formaldehyde down into water and CO₂ through a chemical reaction. It never becomes saturated because it is not storing formaldehyde — it is destroying it. The filter never needs to be replaced and it works continuously, 24 hours a day, for the life of the machine.

Key Features

Three-Stage HEPA H13 Fully Sealed Filtration

Fully sealed, three-stage HEPA H13 grade filtration captures 99.95% of ultra-fine particles. Removes odours and gases. The three stages work together: the catalytic filter destroys formaldehyde, the K-Carbon filter adsorbs NO₂, VOCs and odours, and the HEPA H13 filter captures 99.95% of particulate matter including dust, pollen, bacteria, pet dander and allergens as small as 0.1 microns. Critically, the whole purifier — not just the filtration system — is fully sealed to HEPA H13 grade, which means air cannot bypass the filters through any gap or seam in the machine housing. Every cubic metre of air that enters is cleaned and returned.

Air Multiplier Technology — Whole Room Purification

The TP12 projects over 290 litres per second of smooth, yet powerful cooling airflow. Dyson's Air Multiplier technology amplifies the purified air and projects it across the room, reaching every corner rather than just cleaning the air immediately around the machine. 350° oscillation directs purified airflow around the room. In Auto mode, the machine monitors air quality continuously and automatically adjusts airflow speed to purify the room when pollutants are detected, only using energy when needed. The whole room benefits, not just the area directly in front of the machine.

Intelligent Real-Time Sensing

Integrated sensors analyse your air constantly, while a diagnostic algorithm cross-checks data. It diagnoses pollutants at a molecular level, displaying live results on the LCD screen and in the MyDyson app. The sensors detect PM2.5, PM10, VOCs, NO₂ and formaldehyde levels simultaneously. Every pollutant is monitored and displayed individually so you know exactly what is in your air and what the machine is doing about it. This is genuinely useful for Pakistani homes because you can see in real time when cooking has raised NO₂ levels, when outdoor dust has entered the room, or when a cleaning product has released VOCs.

Dual Function — Purifier and Cooling Fan

The Dyson Purifier Cool PC2 De-NOx can serve as a fan, projecting over 290 litres per second of smooth, yet powerful cooling airflow. It is not an air conditioner. In Pakistan's extreme summer temperatures in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad, this dual function makes the TP12 genuinely useful year-round rather than just during specific months. In summer, it cools while purifying. In cooler months, it runs in diffused mode — directing airflow through the back of the machine to purify without the direct cooling airflow hitting you. One machine, two functions, every season.

Diffused Mode — Purify Without the Breeze

Diffused mode diverts airflow through the back of the machine to purify without cooling you. In winter or in air-conditioned rooms where you do not want additional airflow, diffused mode keeps the purification running silently without directing air at you. The room is being cleaned without you feeling the output at all.

Night Mode for Uninterrupted Sleep

Night mode reduces airflow speed and dims the LCD screen to its lowest level for quiet, unobtrusive operation while you sleep. The machine continues purifying through the night so the air in your bedroom is clean by morning. For Pakistani families who sleep in rooms with windows closed during summer or in homes with gas heaters running in winter, overnight purification makes a meaningful difference to air quality during the hours when you spend the most time in one room.

MyDyson App — Full Remote Control and Scheduling

Control and monitor air quality from anywhere using the MyDyson app, or hands-free with compatible voice services. Set a seven-day schedule for your machine to operate at specific times, day or night. Explore live and historical data to monitor indoor environmental trends in your home. You can set the machine to switch on before you wake up so the bedroom air is already clean when you start your day. You can check air quality remotely while you are out. You can review historical air quality data to understand how your indoor air changes with seasons, cooking patterns or outdoor pollution events. The TP12 connects with Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home and other Matter-compatible platforms for smart home control.

Magnetised Remote Control

The curved remote control is magnetised and stores neatly on top of the machine when not in use. All key functions — standby, airspeed up and down, oscillation, information menu, auto mode, airflow direction and night mode — are accessible from the remote. Nothing needs to be set through a separate control panel or app unless you want the advanced scheduling and monitoring features.

Why the TP12 De-NOx Is the Right Air Purifier for Pakistan

Pakistan has some of the worst urban air quality in the world. Lahore consistently ranks among the most polluted cities globally during winter months. Karachi's industrial zones, vehicle density and coastal humidity create a particular combination of outdoor pollutants. Islamabad, despite its greener environment, still deals with significant seasonal smog. Every major Pakistani city has an outdoor air quality problem that enters homes through ventilation.

But the indoor pollutants that the TP12 De-NOx addresses are equally important and far less discussed. NO₂ from gas stoves, formaldehyde from furniture, VOCs from cleaning products and aerosols, dust and pollen from windows and doors — these are daily, persistent sources of indoor pollution in Pakistani homes. No standard air purifier addresses all of them. The TP12 De-NOx specifically does.

  • Filtration: Three-stage HEPA H13, captures 99.95% of ultra-fine particles
  • Formaldehyde: Permanent catalytic filter, never needs replacing
  • NO₂ Removal: K-Carbon filter, adsorbs 50% more NO₂ than standard carbon
  • Airflow: 290 litres per second maximum

  • Connectivity: MyDyson app, Alexa, Google Home, Apple Home, Siri, Matter
  • Height: 1050mm
  • Weight: 4.9kg
  • Power: Corded, standby consumption under 0.5W

Frequently Asked Questions

What does De-NOx mean and why does it matter for Pakistani homes?

The Dyson Purifier Cool PC2 De-NOx captures 50% more nitrogen dioxide than standard purifiers using a K-Carbon filter impregnated with potassium carbonate. NO₂ is a common and potentially harmful household pollutant produced by gas appliances, open flames and wood burning stoves. In Pakistani homes where gas stoves are used for every meal, NO₂ is produced in the kitchen three or more times daily and spreads through the home. The De-NOx designation means this purifier specifically addresses that pollutant at a level no standard purifier can match.

How is the De-NOx model different from a standard Dyson purifier?

The Dyson Purifier Cool PC2 De-NOx has all the capabilities of Dyson's Purifier Cool Formaldehyde products but goes a step further to capture more NO₂. A standard Dyson purifier captures particles, destroys formaldehyde and removes some gases and VOCs. The De-NOx model adds the K-Carbon filter with potassium carbonate, which specifically targets and removes nitrogen dioxide at a 50% higher rate than regular activated carbon. If you cook with gas, the De-NOx model is the meaningfully better choice.

Does the formaldehyde filter ever need replacing?

The formaldehyde-destroying catalytic filter never needs replacing. It works by destroying formaldehyde through a chemical reaction that converts it into water and CO₂. Because it destroys rather than stores formaldehyde, it never becomes saturated and continues working for the life of the machine. The HEPA and K-Carbon filter does need replacing approximately once a year under regular use, and the MyDyson app or LCD screen will notify you when it is time.

Is the TP12 De-NOx an air conditioner?

No. The Dyson Purifier Cool PC2 De-NOx can serve as a fan which can help cool you. It projects over 290 litres per second of smooth, yet powerful cooling airflow. It is not an air conditioner. It does not lower room temperature the way an AC unit does. It moves purified air powerfully enough to create a cooling effect on your skin in summer, similar to a high-quality fan, while simultaneously purifying the air. In winter or when cooling is not needed, diffused mode directs airflow away from you so the purification continues without the direct airflow.

What pollutants does the TP12 De-NOx detect and display?

Integrated sensors analyse your air constantly and diagnose pollutants at a molecular level, displaying live results on the LCD screen and in the MyDyson app. The sensors monitor PM2.5 (fine particulate matter), PM10 (coarse particulate matter), VOCs (volatile organic compounds from cleaning products, paints and aerosols), NO₂ (nitrogen dioxide from gas cooking and burning), formaldehyde and overall air quality index. Each pollutant is shown individually so you know specifically what is being detected and removed.

How large a room does the TP12 De-NOx cover?

The TP12 De-NOx is rated for room coverage of 81m³, which is the equivalent of a medium to large bedroom or living room in a typical Pakistani home. With 350° oscillation it directs purified airflow around the room rather than in a single direction, which distributes clean air across the full room volume more efficiently than a standard purifier with fixed-direction airflow.

Can I control the TP12 De-NOx with my phone?

Yes. Control and monitor air quality from anywhere using the MyDyson app or hands-free with compatible voice services. Set a seven-day schedule for your machine to operate at specific times, day or night. Explore live and historical data to monitor indoor environmental trends in your home. The TP12 also connects with Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home and other Matter-compatible platforms for smart home control. You can check air quality while you are out, schedule the machine to run before you return home and review weeks of historical air quality data through the app.

How often do the filters need replacing?

The formaldehyde-destroying catalytic filter never needs replacing. The HEPA and K-Carbon filter is recommended to be replaced every 12 months based on 12 hours a day of use. This may vary depending on usage and pollution levels. You will be notified via the MyDyson app or LCD screen when it is time to replace the filter. In Pakistani cities with higher pollution levels, the filter may need replacing sooner than the 12-month guideline. The notification system takes the guesswork out of it entirely.

Does the TP12 De-NOx work quietly enough for a bedroom?

Yes. The machine has a dedicated Night mode that reduces airflow speed and dims the LCD screen to its lowest setting for unobtrusive overnight operation. The sound level at maximum is 61.5dB. At lower speeds appropriate for overnight use, the sound level is significantly quieter than that maximum. The machine continues purifying through the night in Night mode so the air in your bedroom is clean throughout your sleep.

Dyson Purifier Big and Quiet Formaldehyde BP04 Air Purifier

The Dyson Purifier Big and Quiet Formaldehyde BP04 is Dyson's most powerful, most capable and quietest air purifier ever built. Our quietest, most powerful air purifier. Purifies large spaces up to 100m³. Our most advanced filtration system yet. While the TP12 De-NOx is designed for individual rooms, the BP04 is engineered specifically for large living spaces, open-plan homes and connected rooms where a single machine needs to deliver meaningful purification across a genuinely large area. It is Dyson's first purifier specifically engineered to purify properly in spaces up to 1,000 square feet.

It does this while being Dyson's quietest purifier — producing just 56 decibels of noise, making it Dyson's quietest yet most powerful purifier. More power, more coverage, less noise. For Pakistani homes with large drawing rooms, open kitchen and living areas or combined family spaces, the BP04 is the only purifier in the market built to handle what those spaces actually demand.

The Problem With Standard Purifiers in Large Pakistani Rooms

Most air purifiers on the Pakistani market are sized for bedrooms and small rooms. They work adequately in a closed 15m² to 25m² space. But Pakistani homes — particularly in Karachi's DHA and Clifton, Lahore's Gulberg and Model Town, and Islamabad's F and E sectors — often have large drawing rooms, open dining and kitchen combinations, and high-ceilinged spaces that standard purifiers cannot meaningfully clean. A small purifier in a large room creates a clean zone immediately around itself and leaves the rest of the room untouched.

The BP04 was built specifically to solve this problem. Cone Aerodynamics creates a condensed jet of air to project purified air over 32 feet — reaching across even the largest drawing rooms and open-plan spaces in Pakistani homes. Every cubic metre of air in the room passes through the machine and is returned clean.

Cone Aerodynamics — Why the BP04 Reaches Further

The BP04 does not use the Air Multiplier technology found in Dyson's smaller purifiers. It uses an entirely new system called Cone Aerodynamics. Cone Aerodynamics drives high-velocity air jets over the machine's dome which coalesce to project a focused stream of air to purify large spaces, quietly, or cool you when required. High-velocity air jets from the machine's base travel up over the dome, merge at the top and project as a single focused stream that carries purified air across the full length of a large room. The physics of the cone shape allows significantly more airflow projection than a standard circular nozzle, which is why the BP04 can reach 32 feet when smaller purifiers struggle to effectively cover 15 feet.

This new airflow delivery system offers more than double the airflow of previous models. More airflow means faster air changes per hour in large rooms, which means pollutants are removed more quickly and the room reaches clean air faster after a cooking event, a pollution spike or a dusty day.

Three-Stage Filtration — The Most Advanced System Dyson Has Built

HEPA H13, K-Carbon and SCO filtration captures particles and gases including formaldehyde within a fully sealed machine. So what goes inside, stays inside. The three stages work together to handle every category of indoor air pollutant:

360° HEPA H13 Filter — 5 Years Before Replacing

An advanced 360° HEPA H13 grade filter captures allergens and 99.97% of fine particles. The HEPA filter does not need replacing for up to 5 years. The 360° design means the filter wraps around the entire base of the machine rather than sitting in a single panel, giving it dramatically more surface area than standard flat-panel HEPA filters. More surface area means lower air resistance, which allows higher airflow without increased noise — the key engineering reason the BP04 can move more air while staying quieter than smaller purifiers.

K-Carbon Filter — 3x More NO₂ Removed

Impregnated with potassium carbonate, the K-Carbon filter adsorbs three times more NO₂ than previous Dyson carbon filters. It removes a common and potentially harmful pollutant and lasts two years. For Pakistani homes where gas stoves produce NO₂ multiple times daily, and where cooking smells, VOCs from cleaning products and gases from furniture and paint accumulate in large living spaces, the K-Carbon filter is the critical component. Three times more NO₂ removal than standard carbon means meaningfully cleaner air in homes where gas cooking is the norm. It is 30% faster at reducing cooking odours by 97%.

SCO Catalytic Filter — Formaldehyde Destroyed Permanently

The Selective Catalytic Oxidisation filter destroys formaldehyde through a chemical reaction that converts it into water and CO₂. The formaldehyde-destroying catalytic filter never needs replacing. Unlike carbon filters that capture and store formaldehyde until they become saturated, the SCO filter eliminates it entirely and continuously. It never becomes less effective. It works at the same rate on day one as it does in year five. For homes with new furniture, new flooring, fresh paint or composite wood products — all common in new Pakistani homes — this permanent formaldehyde destruction is a long-term air quality investment that compounds over time.

Key Features

CO₂ Sensor — Ventilation Alert

The BP04 alerts you when CO₂ levels are too high. CO₂ is not a pollutant the BP04 can filter — no air purifier can. But elevated CO₂ indicates that the room needs ventilation because too many people have been in a closed space for too long. The CO₂ sensor monitors levels and alerts you through the LCD screen and the MyDyson app when it is time to open a window. This is a feature that exists on no other consumer air purifier in Pakistan's market and it makes the BP04 genuinely useful for monitoring overall room habitability, not just particle pollution.

Captures 99.9% of Viruses

The BP04 captures 99.9% of viruses. The HEPA H13 filtration operates at a fine enough particle size to capture virus-sized particles within a fully sealed machine. For Pakistani families with young children, elderly members or anyone with compromised immunity, this level of biological filtration adds a layer of protection that standard air purifiers at lower price points cannot provide.

Night Mode — 50% Quieter

Night mode is 50% quieter than other Dyson purifiers, allowing for adjusted airflow with minimal noise. In Night mode the machine reduces fan speed and dims all display lighting to its minimum. The room continues being purified through the night. For large bedrooms, master suites or open sleeping areas in Pakistani homes, having a purifier large enough to cover the space while running quietly enough not to disturb sleep is something the BP04 achieves uniquely well.

Most Advanced Sensor Suite

The most advanced suite of sensors interact with Dyson's unique algorithm, cross-checking pollution data every second and reporting live results onscreen or on the MyDyson app. The BP04 monitors PM2.5, PM10, VOCs, NO₂, formaldehyde and CO₂ simultaneously. Every reading is cross-checked by the algorithm before being displayed — which means the data shown is accurate rather than reactive to momentary spikes. Real-time readings appear on the LCD screen and in the app with full historical data for tracking indoor air quality trends over days, weeks and months.

Wheels for Easy Repositioning

The BP04 is Dyson's largest purifier and at 4.9kg it is not something you pick up and carry. It has integrated wheels at the base for easy repositioning between rooms without lifting. For a Pakistani household that wants to move the purifier from the drawing room during the day to a bedroom at night, or from the dining area during meals to the living room afterward, the wheels make this practical and effortless.

MyDyson App and Smart Home Integration

Connect and control air quality, hands-free, with compatible smart home voice services. The BP04 connects to the MyDyson app for full remote control, scheduling, air quality monitoring and historical data review. It also integrates with Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Apple Home, Siri and Matter-compatible platforms. Set weekly schedules for the machine to run at specific times, check air quality from anywhere in the world and receive alerts when pollutant levels rise or filters need attention.

BP04 vs TP12 De-NOx — Which One Is Right for Your Home

Both are excellent Dyson purifiers. The right choice depends on your room size and primary use case.

  • TP12 De-NOx — Best for individual rooms up to 81m³. More compact. Also functions as a powerful cooling fan. Better for bedrooms, studies and smaller living spaces.
  • BP04 — Best for large rooms and open-plan spaces up to 100m². Cone Aerodynamics projects air 32 feet. 3x more NO₂ removal, 5-year HEPA filter, CO₂ sensing. Better for drawing rooms, open kitchen and dining combinations, and large family spaces.

For the largest rooms in Pakistani homes — the drawing room, the combined dining and lounge area, or any space where the family gathers — the BP04 is the machine that actually covers the space properly.

  • Particle Capture: 99.97% of particles as small as 0.3 microns
  • Virus Capture: 99.9% of viruses
  • Formaldehyde: SCO catalytic filter, permanent destruction, never needs replacing
  • NO₂: K-Carbon filter, 3x more than standard carbon filters, 2-year lifespan
